title: Draw squares of each size
prompt: For each size in the array, draw a square: forward that size then turn left, four times. [10] gives eight instructions; [10, 20] gives sixteen.
hints: A loop inside a loop: the outer picks the size, the inner draws four sides.
`for size in sizes:` then `for i in range(4):` with the two calls.

docs.name: for item in list:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines once per item, with item holding each value in turn.

docs.name: move_forward(distance)
docs.what: Drives the turtle forward that many pixels, drawing a line.

docs.name: turn_left()
docs.what: Turns the turtle 90 degrees to the left.

docs.name: range(n)
docs.what: The numbers 0 up to n - 1, for a for loop to count through.
